Exact symbolic replay and rational witnesses agree. The proof states exact-arithmetic and scope limits explicitly.

value.rationale: The result isolates a structural failure mode of residual minimization: even a completely decoupled positive diagonal system can acquire a negative coordinate solely because one Krylov polynomial is shared across spectral modes. The exact threshold, joint minimality in dimension and iteration, and irreducible Stieltjes witness make the statement useful for positivity-sensitive linear solves and for deciding when projection or constrained Krylov machinery is mathematically necessary rather than cosmetic.
